gates.name: G0 package/inspection
gates.acceptance: No OPEN critical footprint or pulse/current rating; independent review of physical orientation. No assembly based on generic pin count.

gates.name: G1 low-voltage logic
gates.acceptance: Reset default off; valid ARM only with PREPARE and KEY/SLOT low; settled measured ARM delay covers captured-output settling; no false permission on clear release/brownout.

gates.name: G2 lease/config/fault state
gates.acceptance: Missing progress disables both paths within250 ms including physical withdrawal. Any SCL low destroys ARM; health recovery while ARM high never rearms. KEY pause leaves intentional in-slot carrier. Capture must not transfer live RF paths.

gates.name: G3 converter dummy load
gates.acceptance: 10 V/13.5 V profile rails within agreed±3% target, no excessive startup/feedback-switch overshoot; actual raw UV/OV thresholds and4S full dropout documented. Input FET off for wrong pack; verify PA_RAIL_ADC accuracy and refusal to assert SLOT on missing/low converter rail. Boost compensation/current limit stable with chosen effective L/C.

gates.name: G4 driver-fault fixture
gates.acceptance: Driver plane remains≤9.5 V, hard trip/disconnect including Q304≤20 µs, no parasitic spike approaching10 V absolute maximum. Verify capacitor ESR≤0.2 Ω and resistor pulse rating; measure PACK_RUN/RAIL_RUN and actual gate decay under the relevant fault. Fail means NO-GO for driver connection.

gates.name: G5 AF/series modulator
gates.acceptance: Stable load/command steps and sine response with no sustained oscillation; no stored-command burst; correct no-tone baseline; supply feedback/command clipping documented. ≤5% engineering envelopeTHD,70–80% nominal depth after calibration. SOA trajectory/hot case acceptable. Inject the VPA sense threshold using a bounded source with the pass device absent; verify the nominal12.63 V equivalent trip and deliberate rearm.

gates.name: G6 synthesizer/source
gates.acceptance: Championship range and better50 ppm over qualified temperature/supply/aging budget. Source fundamental sufficient for calculated driver input without violating continuous input ratings. Close-in products/phase noise recorded; harmonic filtering/clock-disable behavior demonstrated.

gates.name: G7 driver standalone
gates.acceptance: Across band/hot samples: P1dB≥27.2 dBm or recalculated gain/backoff gate; required output24.11 dBm at conservative15 dB PA gain has≥3 dB compression reserve. Measure actual compression/spurs and source-drive adequacy. No reliance on bracketing typical data alone.

gates.name: G8 PA/matching standalone
gates.acceptance: No oscillation during biased/muted/drive/source/load sweeps. Establish≥6.103 W capability before output-filter loss, or recompute for measured filter;≥5.135 W connector capability. Record gain vs drain voltage, drive, temperature and mismatch. Native matching is EVAL TUNE.

gates.name: G9 integrated trueAM
gates.acceptance: At full sizing plane,1.259 W carrier/4.079 W PEP at80% is an investigation target; actual operatingERP guarded by measured antenna/uncertainty. Depth70–80%, initial envelopeTHD≤5%, sideband symmetry≤1 dB; no flattened crests or unacceptable AM-to-PM. Measure carrier-only and all PWM/tone profiles.

gates.name: G10 spectrum/shaping
gates.acceptance: National mask must be selected before compliance claim. Provisional internal harmonic/spur objective≤−60 dBc; close-in products recorded separately. No unapproved keying bursts, PWM sidebands or retune chirp. Reference analyzer dynamic range and attenuation.

gates.name: G11 thermal/mismatch
gates.acceptance: PA/pass/helper estimated junction≤125°C design gate and within exact SOA; no driver ground lead above95°C. MOSFET drain waveform≤32 V engineering ceiling, never40 V absmax. Current/thermal trip deterministic, no automatic rearm. Mechanically intact thermal contact verified.

gates.name: G12 training
gates.acceptance: Calibrate nominal1 µW carrier, optional1–10 µW pads; record PEP/mean/depth and emission spectrum. Unarmed/between-slot output target<0.1 µW and<−60 dBc where measurement permits; this finite threshold is not an IARU exemption. Correct keyed sine waveform.

gates.name: G13 port isolation/faults
gates.acceptance: No conductive watt path; off-port measured below the agreed training ceiling, no damaging power. Initialnormal-to-training isolation target≥80 dB and off-slot silence test with sensitive receiver. PCB/antenna coupling cannot be proven by Boolean or netlist tests.

gates.name: G14 endurance/system
gates.acceptance: ≥12 h selected maximum and≥24 h selected reduced setting still meeting ERP minimum/modulation; no automatic power reduction. Log every rail/current/temperature and full4S accessible energy. Beacons tested against a separate duration requirement.

gates.name: G15 radiated field/legal
gates.acceptance: ERP uncertainty supports selected0.25–1 W interval; no off-slot antenna radiation; country/profile permission valid; correct>200 kHz simultaneous separation. Training field criteria recorded separately.
